# FederationBank fee-round validation — Semantic Source Control v0.2.1

Environment: ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 debug build.

Real sealed FederationBank v0.6 source scan:

  v0.2 external candidates:    101
  of which bogus SQL CALLs:     83
  v0.2.1 external candidates:   18
  expected real SQL boundaries: 18

The false positives were ordinary package-level Rexx test statements such as:

  call assert sql~pos("COMMIT;") > 0, "..."

They are now retained as Rexx/message-use evidence and do not generate external
SQL tracking proposals.

Compatibility/evolution test used the original FederationBank level-5 semantic
repository with only its first 18 accepted SQL decisions. No level-6 decisions
or proposals were present before the test.

Scanning the real sealed v0.6 source under v0.2.1 produced:

  files=47
  packages=37
  classes=54
  methods=323
  messageUses=5486
  externalCandidates=18
  trackingProposalsPending=0
  proposal ledger after scan=18

All 18 candidates resolved to the 18 accepted level-5 external operations.
The three SQL operations extracted from commitTransfer into
commitTransferPostings retained their historical IDs:

  EO-d1cde19036334db88939  INSERT FEDERATIONBANK_TRANSACTIONS
  EO-3af70211afb0a518b3e3  INSERT FEDERATIONBANK_LEDGER_POSTINGS
  EO-31849e81924c192ec8c7  INSERT FEDERATIONBANK_TRANSACTION_DECISIONS

The v0.5 -> v0.6 semantic comparator reports 42 deltas:

  3  CLASS_ADDED
  2  PACKAGE_ADDED
 19  METHOD_ADDED
  1  METHOD_REMOVED
  4  METHOD_CONTRACT_CHANGED
  9  METHOD_IMPLEMENTATION_CHANGED
  3  SQL_WRITE_COLUMNS_CHANGED
  1  SQL_PROJECTION_OR_ORDER_CHANGED

This validates both the proposal-noise repair and external-operation identity
continuity through the real FederationBank fee refactor.
